actual_scope: Prove that the antipodal length-sixteen spinor distance model has at most 632 codewords, or 316 spinor lines, by an integral Fourier-square floor.
scope_change_reason: This is a geometric side bound answering PR5206, rather than a completed paid decoder itinerary. It adds integrality to the real two-point model and improves its integer cap by one line.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result: the D16+ roots-plus-spinors family has at most 556 lines. No paid profile, physical decoder, compensation or supplier gain is inferred.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified improvement, the exclusion of 317 antipodal pairs; do not extend to even pair counts or a three-point search.
